source_refs.note: Exercise 12.3, Question 6: continuity of a piecewise cost function at x = 100 (book p.236). Answer key PDF 310: yes.

blocks.prompt: 6 The factory's cost function is given as: \[C(x) = \begin{cases} 10x + 500, & x \le 100 \\ 12x + 300, & x > 100 \end{cases}\]Is the cost function continuous at \(x = 100\)?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh factory ki cost ka sawal hai jo do formulas mein di gayi hai: 100 units tak ek formula, 100 se zyada par doosra.
Humein dekhna hai ke \(x = 100\) par dono formulas ek hi cost dete hain ya cost achanak uchhal jati hai.
Plan: \(C(100)\), LHL aur RHL nikalein aur teeno shartein check karein.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(x \le 100\) ke liye \(C(x) = 10x + 500\), aur \(x > 100\) ke liye \(C(x) = 12x + 300\).
Humein find karna hai: kya \(C\) point \(x = 100\) par continuous hai?
Tareeqa: \(C\) point \(x = c\) par continuous tab hai jab (i) \(C(c)\) defined ho, (ii) \(\lim_{x \to c} C(x)\) exist kare yani LHL = RHL, (iii) yeh limit \(C(c)\) ke barabar ho. Business ki zubaan mein: \(c\) par cost achanak uchhalti (jump) nahi.

Shart (i): \(C(100)\) nikalein
\[C(100) = 10(100) + 500\]
\[= 1000 + 500 = 1500\]
Kyun: Pehle formula ke saath \(x \le 100\) hai, is liye 100 units pehle formula mein aate hain.

Left hand limit nikalein
\[\lim_{x \to 100^-} C(x) = \lim_{x \to 100^-} (10x + 500)\]
\[= 1500\]
Kyun: 100 se kam units (99, 99.9) par pehla formula chalta hai.

Right hand limit nikalein
\[\lim_{x \to 100^+} C(x) = \lim_{x \to 100^+} (12x + 300)\]
\[= 1200 + 300 = 1500\]
Kyun: 100 se zyada units par doosra formula chalta hai. \(12 \times 100 = 1200\), phir 300 jama.

Shart (ii) aur (iii)
\[\text{LHL} = \text{RHL} = 1500 = C(100)\]
Kyun: Teeno shartein poori hain, is liye \(C\) point \(x = 100\) par continuous hai. Matlab: 100 units ki hadd paar karte waqt cost mein koi achanak chhalaang nahi aati; sirf barhne ki raftaar (10 se 12 per unit) badalti hai.
Dhyan dein: Formula badal jane ka matlab discontinuity nahi. Faisla hamesha values milaa kar karein.

Tasdeeq
\[C(99) = 990 + 500 = 1490\]
\[C(101) = 1212 + 300 = 1512\]
Kyun: 100 se zara kam aur zara zyada units par cost 1500 ke qareeb hi hai. Koi bara jump nahi.
blocks.final_answer: Haan. \(C\) point \(x = 100\) par continuous hai (LHL \(=\) RHL \(= C(100) = 1500\))
